rationale: The only candidate (6a72a15a62bf) is a feature commit that automates requirements installation and renames the class attribute DESCRIPTION to description; the docstring-fallback logic this change added is kept unchanged, so no defect is repaired.
The only candidate (2f5060963aeb) is a naming refactor that renames list_lightningapps to list_apps and re-joins the identical project_id= keyword call onto one line; no bug is fixed.

The fake-reauthentication fix narrows an outer `except BraviaTVAuthError` handler (not added by this change's diff) to the connect step and only re-indents the PSK/PIN connect lines this change added; the other candidates are a client-id/constructor change touching a pre-existing connect line and a media-browsing feature.

This change only renamed the meta attribute tested by the filter (_ModelSiloLimit__silo_limit to silo_limit); the later commit extends the codemod script with an all_silo_model category and drops the filter as part of that redesign, not to repair the rename.

Both candidates are refactors: a2fbca050e0c adapts to active_organization becoming a context object (.organization.slug) and e2950026e8a3 removes the client-state redirect entirely; neither repairs a defect in this change.

This change is a behaviour-preserving extraction of _create_missing_fk_index() made as preparation ('Refs #31335'); the ticket fix repairs a long-standing MySQL problem with removing Meta constraints/indexes on foreign keys and rewrites index-detection logic that this change only moved and reformatted.

The only candidate (8f1269283f3a) adds a CSVLogger for Lightning Lite and moves the logger implementation into lightning_fabric, deleting finalize() from this file as part of that move; it is a feature/refactor, not a repair of the None guard.

This change is a pure variable rename, and both candidates are feature work (help without a running app; standalone logs command that swaps raises for print plus exit) that restructure the renamed lines rather than fix a bug.

The new get_blame_for_file interpolates name, owner, ref and path into the GraphQL query without quotes (invalid string arguments) and returns the blame object instead of blame.ranges; the fix adds the quotes and the .get('ranges', []) step.
The only candidate ('hoists args out of else block') moves `args = None` above the if/elif chain with identical behaviour; it is a refactor, not a bug fix.

This change calls features.has('organizations:customer-domains', last_org) with a possibly-None org and the later commit adds a `last_org is not None` guard, but that commit is a test-helper validation change ('fix(tests)') and the bundle does not show that the None call caused a functional failure.

The fix repairs transformed-transaction search, a bug outside these lines, and in this file only widens the where-column whitelist from tags[environment] to also accept tags[transaction]; the environment filter and the raise for unsupported columns that this change added are kept and worked as intended.
